svg.aria-label: Neralu: Heatwave check-ins for older people. Calls people who live alone when the heat crosses their own threshold, in Kannada, Hindi or English. A worrying answer sends a volunteer to the door. Built for: Hack4SDG 2026 finale. Key result: 287 tests. Built with: FastAPI, Twilio, React.
